bio.text: Lucas Cayler is a Republican who represents District 11 (Seat B) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a first term; the directory lists Cayler as a service technician.
According to the legislature's biography, Cayler was born in Nampa and joined the U.S. Navy in 1999, spending ten years on active duty and deploying twice before an honorable discharge in 2009.
It says Cayler worked for BAE Systems as an Army civilian contractor from 2009 to 2012 and has worked at Cobalt Truck Equipment since 2012.
